author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam meets artist and puppet maker Laura Mathews (@LauraMathewsArt ), who designs and builds incredible winged puppets! Laura introduces Adam to a selection of her creatures, each with articulated wings inspired by real-life biological mechanics. These birds and dragons leap to life in the cave, full of character and personality as they perch on Adam's hands!

Find more of Laura's puppets and projects here: https://www.lauramathewsart.com/ and https://www.youtube.com/LauraMathewsArt
Laura's articulated creature kits: https://www.lauramathewsart.com/shop-1

Shot and edited by Joey Fameli
Music by Jinglepunks
